chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, he said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'One who reces Surahs while attending Congregation Prayer behind an Imam, will not be considered a follower of Islam after his death.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of reciting Surahs behind an Imam in congregational prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates that Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (peace be upon him) stated that a person who recites Surahs during congregational prayer behind an Imam will be resurrected not following the fitrah (natural disposition/true faith) of Islam. This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the jurisprudential significance of individual recitation (Qira'ah al-Fard) versus following the Imam in congregational settings, linking this specific act of worship to one's ultimate spiritual state and adherence to the true nature of Islam.
